subject: MSstats is not available for R version 3.5.3

messages.author: 22ceb8f68b404911
messages.subject: MSstats is not available for R version 3.5.3
parts:
Hi,

I tried downloading MSstats but I got this error message: 

Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘MSstats’ is not available (for R version 3.5.3)

Should I downgrade R to install it? To which version?

Thanks,
Sapir

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSstats is not available for R version 3.5.3
parts:
Dear Sapir,

I guess that you tried to install MSstats through CRAN, 'install.packages('msstats')'

However, MSstats is available in Bioconductor. Please install MSstats (or MSstatsTMT, MSstatsQC) through bioconductor. Both below should work.

HTH
- Meena

source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("MSstats")

or

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("MSstats", version = "3.8")
